card.name: Spots just before the verb provide
card.fires_on: Words right before a likely 'provide/provides' in text about fat, lipid emulsions, calories and energy sources, including partway through names like CLINIMIX and pemmican. It also fires on small linking words such as 'to', 'will' and 'they'.

modes.label: Lipid and nutrition products
modes.description: Inside or right after lipid emulsion and parenteral nutrition names or terms, where 'provide' (calories, fatty acids) would come next.

modes.label: Fat as energy source
modes.description: Linking word or noun in general text about fat or food giving energy, just before 'provide'.
modes.example: "You can carry a light load of fat, and it<< will>> provide a lot of energy."

modes.label: Purpose phrase
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'in order' in lipid emulsion advice, leading into a purpose verb.
